props.name: onError
props.doc: Submitting failed. Only ever about the submit; draft problems go to onDraftProblem.

props.name: drafts
props.doc: What drafts need from the host (drafts contract section 3): a scope, and a key (device mode) or three functions (server mode). In session mode a scope and owner are optional and key the tab's copy. `mode: 'off'` stores nothing anywhere, whatever the schema asks for.

props.name: onDraftProblem
props.doc: A drafts problem: a fallback to session, or a draft that could not be read, loaded or saved.

props.name: assetBase
props.doc: Where the host serves its own files, for image, video, captions and audio files whose source is a root-relative path (contract sections 9–11). A host served under a sub-path passes it — e.g. Vite's `import.meta.env.BASE_URL` — so "/images/a.png" loads from "/app/images/a.png". Unset, such paths load from the page's origin. `https://` sources ignore it.

props.name: validators
props.doc: The host's own checks (contract section 16), run with the built-in ones: on Next, Submit and Return to review, and live on flagged questions. Pass the same array to prepareSubmission on the server, or they can be bypassed. Checked at mount and whenever a different array is passed.

props.name: onRenderError
props.doc: The form could not be shown (contract section 7). In its place the respondent sees "This form can't be shown right now. Please try again later." and the rest of the host's page renders as usual. - A schema or a setting the renderer refuses (the schema's checks, a blank formId or formVersionId, `endpoint`, `validators`) is caught while the form renders, so the message is rendered on the server too. `info` is then `{}`. - Any other error while rendering is caught in the browser, with `info.componentStack`. On the server React has no error boundaries. Called in the browser only, once per failure however often the host re-renders. Each failure is also logged with console.error, and on the server once per render. The form is shown again as soon as `schema`, `endpoint` and `validators` all pass.
